text:
[RARC.6.5.1] Stream delivery completes within the call that produced the
event ([RARC.5.8.7]): on that call's stack, or in the ordered effects it
returns. Any onward flushing — to disk, to a file, to a remote collector — is
the integrator's, on whatever thread, queue or ring its backend prefers. The
engine keeps no event past the call's return, and flushes nothing.
